messages:
ana: Quick heads-up — we're opening a limited preview for Hosted Omni Proxy. It bundles tool-calling multiplexing, adaptive-rate routing, and sticky-model sessions. Signups via the form below. Preview keys issued next week.

maria: 😍 Nice! When does SDK support land? Any breaking changes to existing streaming clients?

ana: SDK changes are additive. Streaming v1 clients keep working; v2 adds a multiplex header `X-Omni-Session`. Migration notes + examples by EOD Fri.

ken: Will this affect routing costs? Curious about billing and how per-request metering changes.

ana: Short answer: per-token billing unchanged. There's an additional per-tool-call routing surcharge for high-fanout requests (>50 tool calls). We'll surface cost estimates in the console. Rough estimator: 
``
estimate = base_tokens * 1.0 + tool_calls * 0.02
```

tara: Sign me up for the pilot — my team's latency-sensitive flow could benefit from sticky sessions. Is there a form?

ana: https://go.redwood/omni-preview-signup — small cohort (20 teams). We'll prioritize latency-critical + Private-deploy customers.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: omni-proxy-preview v0.9 -> staging at 2028-03-15T02:00Z

maria: Will the canary route be opt-in per-project or global for Hosted?

ana: Opt-in per-project. Console toggle + API flag `omni_proxy=enabled`. Default is off.

ceo-sara: Love this. Primary KPIs to watch: 95th percentile latency and tool-fanout failure rate. Keep updates coming.

ana: I'll post a short runbook + onboarding doc in #docs later today. Ping me if you want early access or a walkthrough.
